findings.harnessBites: Applied proposed fix (normalizedRolesCopy + semantic compare in rolesEqual): contracts -> GREEN, canaries -> FLIP (Red). Reverted; production diff empty. Refinement: copy-only normalization is INSUFFICIENT for convergence (parent stays Recreate); the fix MUST also normalize in rolesEqual/compare.
findings.verdict: Confirmed (unit, deterministic). Live hot-loop RATE (no-op Update -> Owns re-queue) not proven this round; non-convergence itself is unit-proven and holds regardless.

liveNote: Cluster: ACK cn-hongkong, k8s v1.36.1, 3 nodes, running v0.8.0 (pre-enum, webhook-less validating only). enum was temporarily patched onto the RIS CRD for the premise/fix A/B and fully restored after. The webhook-heal admission path is proven at unit level (defaulter.Default) and transitively by the live reconciler proof (same NormalizeUpdateStrategyType); live admission-chain serving was not feasible out-of-cluster (API server cannot reach a host webhook). The PR's own e2e upgrade suite phase 4 is the intended admission-chain proof.
envtestNote: test/envtest harness does NOT wire admission webhooks (no WebhookInstallOptions; SetupRBGController sets up only the reconciler). envtest proves CRD-schema behavior (valid types accepted, update-path works) on a real isolated kube-apiserver, not the webhook heal. B1 (round 2) is unit-only: test/envtest/testutil/setup.go wires no admission webhooks (no WebhookInstallOptions), so the hot-loop rate cannot be observed in envtest; only the compare/copy non-convergence is unit-proven.
